description: Returns what a job pays. In the US, for a metro area, a state or the whole country, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (May 2025, all industries): median yearly pay, the 10th to 90th percentile range and how many people do the job. In Canada, from Statistics Canada: median and average hourly pay for the job group, by province. Elsewhere, average monthly pay of employees by broad job group (managers, professionals, technicians, trades and more) in local currency, from the International Labour Organization's ILOSTAT. Eligible European countries also include the published national minimum wage in euros, where available. Inputs are a job title and, in the US, an optional city or state. Applies to questions about what a job pays. The change in purchasing power of old dollars is outside this result.

country.description: Country name or two-letter code; defaults to the United States

place.description: US only: city ('Seattle', 'Austin, TX'), state ('WA' or 'Washington'), or leave out for national

name: check_wage
title: Wage: what a job pays, by place
